Title: Cybersecurity Analyst
Requirements:
- B.Tech in Computer Science or Information Security
- Minimum 2 years of experience in security operations or vulnerability management
- Must have practical knowledge of Cybersecurity, Network Security, Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Assessment, and OWASP
- Experience testing web application security vulnerabilities
Bonus:
- Hands-on experience with Burp Suite, Wireshark, and Linux is a plus
- Security certifications like CEH or CompTIA Security+ are preferred
